'''Defender's Emblem''' is the rewards of certain battles. The [[Keeper]] can deliver it to the [[Barracks]] to increase the number of squads by 1.

A total of 4 emblems can be obtained. The first one is obtained as a reward for the battle in the [[quest]] "[[First... Sludge?]]".
